scientific_integrity: Every claimed universal step is supported by the analytic parity argument, exact fourth-moment identities, compactness, and elimination. Exact-symbolic supplementary checker available. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: All-radius contraction cutoff only concerns centered finite Fourier bandwidths; exact algebraic norm is the r-to-zero limit on the three-character subspace, not an unrestricted or finite-radius norm. No resolution of the complex L-infinity-to-L4 Poisson Schwarz conjecture. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp degree-two Poisson decay and the algebraic three-mode fourth-moment barrier
